plain: Bryce Zabel, a writer and researcher speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show about Hollywood, the CIA and UFOs, points to 1953 as a turning point. He says that in that year the CIA, the US Central Intelligence Agency, convened the Robertson Panel, a group of experts brought together to look at UFO reports. He tells it as the start of the agency's long involvement in how UFOs are presented to the public.
